about: A region condition on RDS (regional) is a real narrowing, as good as a filter: the bullet says it applies in eu-west-1.

controls.output: - RDS instances in eu-west-1 with `MultiAZ` false are flagged. Multi-AZ instances, and any outside eu-west-1, pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-multi-az-eu@1
- RDS instances in eu-west-1 with Multi-AZ disabled are flagged. Multi-AZ instances, and any outside eu-west-1, pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-multi-az-eu@1
- RDS instances with `MultiAZ` false are flagged. Multi-AZ instances pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-multi-az-eu@1
- RDS instances in eu-west-1 with `MultiAZ` true are flagged. Single-AZ instances pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-multi-az-eu@1
- RDS instances outside eu-west-1 with `MultiAZ` false are flagged. Multi-AZ instances pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-multi-az-eu@1
